basin_state.coupled_use: sole accepted surface-water state for represented store

level_demand.semantics: minimum and maximum level are independently optional; allocation targets end-of-allocation-step level/storage range

allocation_controlled_supply.coupled_use: realize WSCAP-like supply capacity and scarcity in Ribasim

tabulated_rating_curve.interpolation: PCHIP between supplied points; Q=0 below lowest supplied level; extrapolation behavior above maximum follows product rule
tabulated_rating_curve.allocation_controlled: allocation chooses flow within predicted physical Q(h) capacity; physical layer applies min(allocated,Q(h)) plus reduction factors
tabulated_rating_curve.q1a_warning: Three-point [-1,0,1] / [0,0,0.5] table is not a linear 0.5*h relation on 0<h<1 because PCHIP sees a flat segment below the crest. Two-point [0,1] / [0,0.5] is the product-native candidate for an exactly linear above-crest relation while the below-lowest rule supplies Q=0.

basin_vertical_forcings.coupled_use: mass-transfer endpoints, not replacements for SWAP constitutive exchange physics

hard_mapping_rules: Do not identify a Ribasim parameter name with SWAP process ownership merely because the names match.
Do not represent the same physical surface-water storage in SWAP and Ribasim.
Do not encode a signed SWAP exchange as a single unsigned Ribasim forcing without preserving direction.
Do not assume TabulatedRatingCurve interpolation is piecewise linear.
Do not use allocation output as accepted physical mass before the coupled physical transaction accepts.
